params.trigger: The P1 pre-registration's rejection condition fired. Measured on one cache after backfill, momentum_6m IC IR fell from 0.18 on the 11-name reference layer to 0.15 on the 25-name candidate layer. Every secondary metric moved the same way.
params.hypothesis: The expansion failed because it added redundancy, not observations. Nine of the fourteen added names (EWJ, IJH, IJR and the six US sector ETFs) are a single highly correlated equity-beta cluster. Nominal cross-sectional count rose from 11 to 25 while effective independent sample size rose far less, and the ranking became dominated by one cluster.
params.rejected_alternative: An earlier reading blamed heterogeneous asset classes. It does not survive inspection: the reference layer already mixes equities, treasuries, credit, gold, commodities and REITs, so the expansion did not introduce that kind of heterogeneity.
params.test_layer: us_asset_rotation_distinct — the 11 reference members plus the five genuinely distinct income and commodity names, excluding the nine redundant equity names.
params.prediction: If redundancy explains the fall, the 16-name distinct layer scores above the 25-name layer's 0.15 and at or above the 11-name reference layer's 0.18.

decision_rule.redundancy_supported: IC IR > 0.18 — rebuild the expansion from distinct names rather than all available tickers
decision_rule.inconclusive: 0.15 < IC IR <= 0.18 — expansion is not the lever; revert to the reference layer and stop expanding
decision_rule.redundancy_rejected: IC IR <= 0.15 — adding names hurts regardless of their distinctness; revert to the reference layer

params.metric_lock: The decision is made on ic_ir alone, the same metric the P1 pre-registration named. Monotonicity is explicitly excluded from the decision: with 11 names across 5 quantiles there are roughly two names per bucket, so the reference layer's 1.00 is not a measurement and must not be cited as evidence in either direction.
params.promotion_disclaimer: No layer measured so far is near the 0.30 promotion gate. Nothing in this experiment can promote anything; it only decides which universe the remaining research runs against.
params.descriptive_only: Mean pairwise correlation of 6-month returns and the implied effective sample size will be recorded per layer to support interpretation. These are descriptive and carry no decision rule.
